dates.prior_version_note: Just-cause eviction provisions of the SF Rent Ordinance predate the documents provided; no start date stated.
Relocation amounts are reset every March 1; the prior period (3/1/25–2/28/26) was $8,062 per tenant, and the archive's earliest listed rate period starts 8/10/06.
Ellis Act relocation amounts are reset every March 1; prior period (3/1/25–2/28/26) was $10,863.45 per tenant.
Annual allowable increase is reset each March 1; the prior period (3/1/25–2/28/26) was 1.4%.
Security deposit interest rate is reset each March 1; the prior period (3/1/25–2/28/26) was 5.0%.

in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: Legislation adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024.

dates.prior_version_note: No earlier SF ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices; Section 37.10C is a new addition to the Rent Ordinance.
The HRC page names the Fair Chance Ordinance but gives no enactment or effective date.
